description: ansible-lint (offline) grouped by rule with counts, severities and file:line locations; never fixes anything (ADT MCP's ansible_lint fixes). dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

paths.description: Paths relative to dir (default: lint's own discovery)
